summary: Entry was strongly favorable early, peaking near +118pts by t=8m with amplitude growing to ~170pts. From t~12m onward the leg reversed into a persistent, monotonic erosion across six consecutive frames (118->92->68->50->35->11pts), a decay pattern too sustained to be normal chop, so I bailed at +11pts before it turned negative. Next time I'd watch for the transition point (t~11-12m) sooner -- multiple consecutive against-fires (HA-against, PROPP-against) plus a rising giveback% on a still-positive leg was the earliest tell that momentum had flipped, and waiting for a 6-frame confirmation gave back most of the peak gain.
